description: This file implements JWT-based OAuth2 authentication endpoints and user management for a FastAPI application, including token creation, user validation, and protected routes.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents an access token with token string and type.

classes.name: TokenData
classes.description: Holds token payload data including username and scopes.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model with basic user info.

classes.name: UserInDB
classes.description: Extends User with hashed_password for database storage.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plain password against a hashed password.

methods.name: get_password_hash
methods.description: Generates a hash for a given password.

methods.name: get_user
methods.description: Retrieves a user from the database by username.

methods.name: authenticate_user
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials against the database.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with expiration.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the current user from token and scopes.

methods.name: get_current_active_user
methods.description: Checks if the current user is active.

methods.name: login_for_access_token
methods.description: Endpoint to login and receive an access token.

methods.name: read_own_items
methods.description: Returns items owned by current user.
